title: hymenium-workflow-v1
description: YAML DAG workflow definition for hymenium. Producer: workflow authors (lamella ships built-in templates). Consumer: hymenium run command, cap workflow builder, septa contract layer.

workflow_id.description: Stable identifier for this workflow (e.g. 'review-pr'). Used by hymenium run and cap to reference the workflow.

description.description: What this workflow does and when to use it.

nodes.description: DAG nodes. Each node has a unique id and a kind that determines its execution behavior.

edges.description: Directed edges defining execution order. A node with no incoming edges runs first.

env.description: Optional key/value pairs available to all nodes as $KEY. Values may be overridden at invocation time via --env KEY=VALUE.

TriggerRule.description: Controls when a node with multiple incoming edges becomes ready. 'all_success': all predecessors must succeed (default). 'one_success': fires as soon as any predecessor succeeds; fault-tolerant fan-in for parallel reviewer branches.

ContextMode.description: Whether the node inherits model context from prior turns ('inherit', default) or starts with a clean slate ('fresh'). Use 'fresh' for synthesis nodes that should reason only from collected outputs.

matcher.description: Pipe-separated tool name pattern applied to tool_name. E.g. 'Write|Edit', 'Bash', '*' for all tools.

additional_context.description: Text appended to the model's next turn when the matcher fires.

system_message.description: Immediate steering message injected as a system turn when the matcher fires.

deny.description: If true, block the matched tool use and return an error. Default false.

id.description: Unique node identifier within the workflow.

allowed_tools.description: If non-empty, restrict the node to only these tool names.

denied_tools.description: Tool names explicitly blocked for the duration of this node.

command.description: Shell command to run. May reference $node_id.output and $ENV_KEY.

until.description: Exit condition checked after each iteration (e.g. 'exit_code == 0', 'no_errors').

skill.description: Lamella skill name to invoke (resolved via PATH or lamella skill-script path).

args.description: Optional arguments passed to the skill.

prompt.description: Message shown to the operator when requesting approval.
